summary: Spaces and the phone now show shared sidebar folders, grouped resources, filtering and device-local collapse choices; empty installs explain how to start

compatibility.detail: Read-only arrangement views use existing optional arrangements capability and collections stream. stui reserves its three conversations and terminal on older daemons; the phone falls back to grouped resources with older pairings. No arrangement edits or new required wire fields.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
